name: SerializationExceptionDesk
tagline: Investigate serialisation and verification alerts – from triage to root cause, CAPA and authority notification.
description: A complete Power Apps app for pharmaceutical serialisation exceptions (EU FMD / DSCSA style): alert register, workflow board, batch clusters with one-click root cause, suspected falsified pathway with quarantine and competent-authority notification, SLA timeline and GS1 GTIN validation. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages; demo mode with fictional data.
features: 10 KPI tiles incl. SLA breached, suspected falsified, awaiting authority notice, quarantined packs
14 quick filters, grouping, sorting, bulk actions
Stage rules: investigator, batch, root cause, CAPA, quarantine, authority notification
Batch cluster matrix with likely-cause hints and one root cause for many alerts
GS1 GTIN check-digit validation and duplicate pack detection
SLA by severity with configurable days
